# awscc_kendra_thesaurus (Data Source)

Data Source schema for AWS::Kendra::Thesaurus



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) Uniquely identifies the resource.

### Read-Only

- `arn` (String) The Amazon Resource Name (ARN) of the thesaurus.
- `description` (String) A description for the thesaurus.
- `index_id` (String) The identifier of the index for the thesaurus.
- `name` (String) A name for the thesaurus.
- `role_arn` (String) An IAM role that gives Amazon Kendra permissions to access the thesaurus file specified in SourceS3Path.
- `source_s3_path` (Attributes) Information required to find a specific file in an Amazon S3 bucket. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--source_s3_path))
- `tags` (Attributes List) A list of key-value pairs that identify or categorize the thesaurus. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tags))
- `thesaurus_id` (String) The identifier of the thesaurus.

<a id="nestedatt--source_s3_path"></a>
### Nested Schema for `source_s3_path`

Read-Only:

- `bucket` (String) The name of the S3 bucket that contains the file.
- `key` (String) The name of the file.


<a id="nestedatt--tags"></a>
### Nested Schema for `tags`

Read-Only:

- `key` (String) The key for the tag.
- `value` (String) The value associated with the tag.
